summary.title: Address PR #112 review findings for the DSH source
summary.what: Hardened the DSH source across catalog gating (reject plain .jsonl drift), contract alignment (createdAt/time required), torn-tail zstd tolerance (UnexpectedEof + 'incomplete frame' only), latest-wins title/model, parent-directory fallback identity, deduped scan-failure messages, checked acceptance-gate root lookup, and reverted an unevaluated SKILL.md trigger list. Added torn/corrupt/incomplete/privacy/e2e tests; verified against the real ~/.dsh library (105 sessions, 0 rejections).

tolerate exactly UnexpectedEof + 'incomplete frame'; every other decode failure remains a hard per-file error
latest wins, matching the pi.rs model_change convention
fall back to the parent directory name (the real dsh session id), not the constant file stem
reverted; repo rule forbids trigger lists without invocation-eval evidence

first title is a truncated first-message paste; refined title and model switches arrive later

review_notes: Gates: cargo fmt/test (189+12)/clippy -D warnings/release build + npm run check all green
Real-data smoke: sync of ~/.dsh/sessions 105 files 0 errors; find (CJK), read-page, read-range, anchor_not_found typed error, evidenceRead argv replay verified
CONSTRAINT: checkpoint DeltaUnsupported forces full replay, so torn-prefix projections are always replaced after dsh repairs the tail
CONSTRAINT: DSH archived sessions are a workspace UI flag (workspace.json archivedSessionIds); files stay in place and remain indexed by construction
ANTI-PATTERN(high): accepting plain .jsonl for dsh in catalog.rs — dsh decodes everything as zstd; drift extensions turn recoverable drift into strict-sync hard failure
ANTI-PATTERN(high): treating any zstd decode error as a torn tail — only UnexpectedEof + 'incomplete frame' signals truncation; other failures mean corruption and must stay hard errors
ANTI-PATTERN(medium): taking the first session/title or request/header model for dsh — latest record wins
ANTI-PATTERN(medium): file-stem fallback identity for dsh — stem is constant session.jsonl; real id is the parent directory name
ANTI-PATTERN(medium): language trigger lists in skill descriptions without invocation-eval failure evidence
RISK: torn-tail tolerance matches the zstd crate 'incomplete frame' string; a dependency upgrade changing it reverts to hard failure (unit tests cover)
RISK: a torn live session indexes only its complete prefix until dsh repairs the tail and the next sync replays
